## Contribution Checklist

Please verify the following requirements before submitting your PR:

- [ ] **Directory & Naming:** The project is contained in its own folder under `agents/<project-slug>/` or `tools/<project-slug>/` using lowercase kebab-case.
- [ ] **Documentation:** A complete `README.md` based on `template/README.md` is present in the project folder with all relevant sections completed.
- [ ] **Reproducible Setup:** Setup and installation instructions were verified from scratch in a clean environment.
- [ ] **Core Functionality Tested:** The agent or tool was executed and confirmed to work as described.
- [ ] **Example Usage:** Realistic input and output examples are provided in the project documentation.
- [ ] **Dependencies Declared:** All external dependencies are tracked in a project manifest (e.g., `requirements.txt`, `package.json`, `pyproject.toml`).
- [ ] **Secrets & Security:** No API keys, credentials, tokens, local `.env` files, or personal data are included in this PR. A `.env.example` is provided if environment variables are required.
- [ ] **Scope Limitation:** Changes are strictly confined to the project's own directory (plus an optional entry in `agents/README.md` or `tools/README.md` index). Unrelated files have not been modified.
